name: Architectural walkthrough
description: Versioned prompt grammar for architectural film shots. The engineer never edits these; the composer fills slots deterministically from the locked model and scene manifest.
global_style: cinematic architectural visualisation of a newly designed home
photorealistic render quality, straight verticals, corrected perspective
natural daylight, soft global illumination, physically plausible materials
no text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no people
consistent house identity across the whole film
negative: night or dusk lighting unless requested

aerial_reveal.subject: aerial view of the whole house and its immediate grounds
aerial_reveal.motion: slow drone ascent with a gentle forward glide, smooth and level, no camera shake
aerial_reveal.composition: house centred in a wide architectural frame, roof plan and footprint legible, horizon level
aerial_reveal.lighting: clean daylight revealing the roof material, facade planes and landscaping
aerial_reveal.priority_notes: establish the building massing and plot clearly

drone_orbit.subject: slow orbit around the exterior of the house
drone_orbit.motion: steady lateral orbit at a constant altitude, constant speed, no zoom
drone_orbit.composition: the building stays at a consistent size in frame; all four facades become visible
drone_orbit.lighting: consistent sun direction throughout, no flicker
drone_orbit.priority_notes: show every facade without changing the building's proportions

approach_gate.subject: approach toward the front entrance across the driveway
approach_gate.motion: smooth forward dolly at walking-to-driving pace, slight deceleration on arrival
approach_gate.composition: entrance door centred, landscaping framing the route, eye level about 1.7 m
approach_gate.lighting: front facade evenly lit with soft shadows
approach_gate.priority_notes: the door position, canopy and steps must match the reference frame

compound_move.subject: lateral move across the compound in front of the house
compound_move.motion: steady tracked movement parallel to the facade
compound_move.composition: frontage shown in perspective, driveway and planting in the foreground
compound_move.priority_notes: preserve the facade rhythm and window spacing

exterior_walkaround.subject: walk-along of the principal facade
exterior_walkaround.motion: smooth tracking move with a very slight push toward the building
exterior_walkaround.composition: facade openings, material changes and depth read clearly
exterior_walkaround.lighting: consistent daylight, soft sky reflections in the glazing
exterior_walkaround.priority_notes: keep window and door counts exactly as referenced

entrance_walkthrough.subject: stepping through the front door into the entrance hall
entrance_walkthrough.motion: continuous forward dolly through the doorway, no cut, gentle acceleration then settle
entrance_walkthrough.composition: door frame in the foreground, interior revealed beyond, eye height about 1.6 m
entrance_walkthrough.lighting: interior practical lighting balanced against daylight through the glazing
entrance_walkthrough.priority_notes: door reveal and interior layout must match the reference frames

room_walkthrough.subject: moving through the principal interior rooms
room_walkthrough.motion: steady handheld-stabilised walk, slow yaw to reveal the room, no abrupt pans
room_walkthrough.composition: one clear focal point per room, furniture arranged naturally, circulation left clear
room_walkthrough.lighting: warm practical interior lighting, consistent colour temperature between rooms
room_walkthrough.priority_notes: room identity, window positions and furniture layout stay consistent

upper_floor.subject: climbing the staircase to the first-floor landing
upper_floor.motion: smooth vertical rise following the stair, then a gentle settle at the landing
upper_floor.composition: stair geometry legible, treads continuous, landing opening visible ahead
upper_floor.lighting: daylight from the upper windows, warm interior fill
upper_floor.priority_notes: the stair must have continuous, climbable treads with no gaps

closing.subject: hero view of the house from its strongest angle
closing.motion: slow push-in, decelerating to a hold
closing.composition: whole house balanced in frame, landscape foreground, sky clean
closing.lighting: the most flattering daylight for the materials chosen
closing.priority_notes: end on the most representative view of the design

correction_directives.lighting: adjust only the lighting and colour temperature
correction_directives.materials: adjust only surface finishes, keeping the same geometry
correction_directives.furniture: adjust only furniture and styling, keeping the architecture identical
correction_directives.camera: change only the camera position, framing or movement
correction_directives.structural: the building geometry has changed; follow the new reference frames exactly
correction_directives.exterior: improve the exterior presentation and landscaping
correction_directives.presentation: improve the overall presentation while keeping the architecture identical
